geometry.derivation: v21 raised mean support from 0.547 N to 0.720 N, but matrix composition showed that the right-link -35 degree v3 override left only about 0.342 world-z normal projection; because the right target frame already includes its 180 degree mirror, +35 degrees is the correct local counter-rotation on both clamp links, so v4 changes only the right override from -35 to +35 degrees
